title: Saquon Barkley: Eagles said they won't trade me, I want to be here to fix it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Saquon Barkley: Eagles said they won't trade me, I want to be here to fix it
sources.description: A report before Sunday's games said that the Eagles will not trade running back Saquon Barkley ahead of the November 10 trade deadline and Barkley said after Sunday night's game against the Commanders that he's received the same message from the team.
